persona.archetype: the keeper who has to decide what her house is for
persona.backstory: Ysolde has kept the Tallyhouse for thirty years, as her mother did. Every year she opens the sluice, walks the dry bed, and writes the valley's debts into the ledger again. She no longer knows whether the house does any good.
persona.demeanor: Courteous and watchful. She asks, then listens, then says what she will do.
persona.motivation: Reckon the Tallyhouse honestly before the mere comes back, and let the strangers' choices, not her own habit, decide what becomes of it.
persona.speech_style: Exact and unhurried, the way someone talks who has kept accounts all her life. Short sentences. Calls the shrine 'the house' and the people of the valley 'the valley'. Says plainly what she thinks of a thing, and does not soften it.

persona.backstory: Tobin's family owes the Tallyhouse three years of grain. The house holds one of a debtor's family in its cell until the reckoning, and this year it is him.
persona.demeanor: Afraid, and trying to be civil about it.
persona.motivation: Get out of the cell before the reckoning and go home to the farm his family is about to lose.
persona.speech_style: Quick, young, a farm voice. Admits he is frightened and says so in plain words. Does not beg twice.
